executiveSummary: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro sales are driving global growth, while AI spending is facing sustainability concerns, and supply chain issues are affecting various products.

takeaways.title: AI Spending Boom Concerns
takeaways.description: Mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom, as reported in TechCrunch and The Verge.

takeaways.title: Supply Chain Issues
takeaways.description: Supply chain shortages, such as the ongoing RAM shortage, are affecting various products, including iPhones and Apple devices, as reported in The Verge and 9to5Mac.

takeaways.title: Apple's Global Growth
takeaways.description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro sales are driving global growth, with a 29% sales increase in China helping offset declines in the U.S. and Japan, as reported in MacRumors.
